layman_headline: The crypto market is scared and most coins look weak — not the time to jump in.
layman_explanation: The overall crypto market is in a 'Fear' state at 27 out of 100, and has been stuck there all week. Bitcoin is down about 2% over the past week, and almost every altcoin on our watchlist is in a downtrend with bearish chart structures. The one coin showing strong momentum (KAITO) is dangerously overbought with an RSI of 87, meaning it's likely to pull back soon. There simply isn't a high-quality setup with good risk-reward right now.
layman_action: Stay in cash and wait. The market is fearful but not yet showing clear reversal signs. A better entry will come when we see oversold coins starting to form bullish reversal patterns with volume confirmation.
expert_reasoning: Systematic review of all 7 candidates: KAITO has the only bullish chart (+1.10) but RSI at 87.19 is extremely overbought — our most reliable signal (RSI, 71% win rate) screams avoid here. TRUMP's RSI of 27 is oversold and normally attractive, but the chart bias is bearish (-0.70), price is below all MAs, and risk-reward is only 0.67x — not enough upside to justify entry in a fearful market. ENA is strongly bearish (-1.70 chart bias) with an Evening Star reversal pattern. PEPE, DASH show bearish structures. FET and MON lack sufficient technical data. With Fear & Greed at 27 and worsening, BTC dominance at 56.4% crushing alts, and negative news flow (ETF outflows, hack losses, mining stress), the prudent move is to preserve capital and wait for a cleaner setup.

context_banner: Market fear is elevated with no quality setups available — capital preservation is the highest-conviction play right now.
